slot.intent: Of everything investors put in, 40% was simply gone: the ring is all the money, and the red slice is the share that disappeared.

concept: The ring is all the money. It draws in as the opening words are read, then an arc sweeps round locked to the count to 40% and lands red; on "gone" that red slice pulls out of the ring.
storyboard: 0.8 s, on "everything": the kicker builds word by word in grey tracked caps above centre while a pale grey ring draws clockwise from twelve o'clock, steady and slowing into its close
3.9 s, just after "40%": an off white arc sweeps clockwise from twelve o'clock over the pale ring, locked to a heavy mono figure counting up at the centre
4.7 s, as the count lands on 40%: the arc and the figure settle from off white to red together, the only accent in the frame
6.0 s, on "gone.": the red slice pulls out of the ring along its middle in one smooth 400 ms move, leaving a gap, as GONE fades in under the figure in small red tracked caps
6.4 s: at rest, the 60% that stayed a quiet pale ring, the slice that went red and apart from it
Then a full hold to the end, nothing moving.
